input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with An automated system is designed to read and recognize vehicle license plates, using optical character recognition to identify and flag suspicious plates. The system aims to alert authorities to potential issues, such as stolen vehicles, by quickly and accurately processing license plate information. This technology is intended to assist law enforcement in their efforts to maintain public safety and enforce traffic regulations.
